developer.title: Developer / Access (Memory MCP)
developer.desc: Bring your Gedo memory into any AI: create an access token and paste it into Claude Code / Claude Desktop / Cursor or any MCP client, which can then search your memories and portrait within the granted scopes. twin.title: Twin Model
twin.tagline: Your own dedicated model — trained on your words, growing more like you, deletable anytime.
twin.gateDesc: The Twin model is an Ultra-exclusive capability.
twin.consentEntryDesc: Train a model that belongs only to you; separate consent, revocable with physical deletion
twin.clause1: Only content you wrote is used (your messages, uploaded writing samples, your own turns in imported chats). AI replies and other people’s words are never used.
twin.clause2: The result is a Twin model that belongs only to you — never merged into any shared model, never usable by others.
twin.clause3: Training data and your Twin are processed on GEDO’s own infrastructure — never sent to third-party AI providers. Sensitive details are removed before training.
twin.clause4: You can revoke anytime — your training data and Twin model will be physically deleted, irreversibly.
twin.clause5: This consent is independent of other data settings; content marked "hidden from AI" never enters training.
twin.consentBeta: Beta terms — you will be asked to re-confirm when the final terms ship.
twin.revokeWarning: Your training data and Twin model will be physically deleted — this cannot be undone. Your persona falls back to the generic mode.
twin.actionImport: You can also import ChatGPT / Claude history in Settings → Privacy to speed things up.
twin.uploadPlaceholder: Paste something you wrote (a message, email or note, 20+ characters)…
twin.activeDesc: Your model v{version} is live — your persona now speaks the way you do.
twin.manageInSettings: Consent and deletion are managed in Settings → Privacy.
